items.title: Manuel "Fess" Manetta Interview, 1957-03-21
items.q: And when Coopty would come to the house, now, like Jelly Roll, I got in with Jelly Roll, he was a nice boy with me.

ctx.x: That's right. That's right. Sure. As long as your wife doesn't mind, we don't mind. She won't hear this.

Well, I had a lady that she ran a house. 1519, Aberdee Street. And she had a lot of stalls in there. In fact, they had white and colored stalls. And she had a little girl. So, I had a piano. Well, the fellas around there, me, I wouldn't allow her to play on the piano, you know, because she was jealous, you know. She didn't want me to play around in there, you see. Well, I kept waiting that kind of bit of. The fellas they had around there, oh, they had a lot of them. Boyman Ham, Black Pete, Jelly Roll, a lot of…
He was a pretty good player, too.
